    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='c']
    if not pts: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return (len(pts),min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
